title: evansia nepalensis
intro: Evansia nepalensis, commonly known as the Nepal ash plant, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health issues. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing fever, treating wounds, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Evansia nepalensis include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
